policy.scope: Every unique canonical system-by-lane occurrence is rescored from the same provider-neutral dossier.

policy.comparisonRule: Rank only within the same channel. Each system/channel contributes at most its best ten eligible candidates.
policy.missingSlotRule: A missing eligible candidate contributes zero to that channel's fixed ten target slots.
